data.name: Nazneen
data.gender_notes: Nazneen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Naz', which means 'to gaze' or 'to look at'. Nazneen means someone who is delicate, dainty and beautiful. The name Nazneen carries the meaning “Delicate, Dainty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazneen usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, dainty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, 'Verily, Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.' (Muslim 91)
data.etymology: Nazneen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Dainty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazneen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nazneen has a rich cultural significance in the Persian and Urdu speaking world. It is considered as a graceful and elegant name. Women bearing this name are often revered for their beauty, charm and poise. Some famous reminders of the name Nazneen include the character Nazneen from the novel and film "East is East" and the Pakistani actress Nazneen Taliha. The name holds a place of honor in many communities due to its association with feminine grace and elegance.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Nazneen can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual significance of self-reflection and introspection. The Arabic root 'Naz' means 'to gaze', reflecting the importance of reflecting upon one's own thoughts, actions, and motivations. By contemplating the inner self, one can gain a deeper understanding of their own spiritual path and grow closer to God. Thus, the name Nazneen can be seen as a call to engage in personal spiritual development, and to approach life with a thoughtful and mindful perspective.
